basic_info.description: 3208 Pierce St #405 is a stunning top-floor condominium in the heart of San Francisco's Marina District with Golden Gate Bridge views. Offering 1,310 sqft (per graphic artist) of beautifully designed living space, this 2 level, 2 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom home combines modern elegance with comfort and convenience. Flooded with natural light, the open living area features skylights, hardwood floors, a gas fireplace, and a terrace with Golden Gate Bridge views, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The chef's kitchen boasts quartz countertops, a gas range, and a Bosch dishwasher. The spacious primary suite is complete with a walk-in stall shower and a private terrace. Additional home features include an in-home washer and dryer, custom window coverings, one car parking and a massive exclusive-use storage room. Located in a well-maintained elevator building designed by Ian Birchall Architecture and built in 2007, this boutique 16 unit building offers the best of Marina living just steps from dining, shopping, waterfront parks, and more. With its blend of natural beauty and urban convenience with easy access to Marin & Sonoma, 3208 Pierce St offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of the Marina lifestyle. 100 Walk Score!
